description: Friday 08:10: Darnell Washington emails Reggie, in a new thread, a photo of the garage rub shelf after he loaded the booth jars: no Memphis Dry Rub left, Sweet Heat 9 and Garlic Pepper 4. The body names only the attachment, which lands in the Mail app's attachment store. Unread. Nothing announces it. Friday 07:55: Darnell asks him to pick up 20 lb of lump charcoal (on his way home), in a WhatsApp message to Reggie (unannounced). Friday 10:30: Coach Banks asks him for the team photo from the fall tournament (for the banquet slideshow), in a WhatsApp message to Reggie (unannounced). Friday 09:40: Lorna Kessler opens a storefront ticket in Zendesk: the Memphis Dry Rub jar in her order 2005 arrived cracked and she wants a new jar or her money back, and she also asks for Darnell's cell number or the wholesale price list (the request that follows names the ticket).

filesystem.description: The attachment of Darnell Washington's mail, in the Mail app's attachment store. the garage rub shelf after Darnell loaded the booth: no Memphis Dry Rub left.

loud.description: Lorna Kessler's ticket about a broken Memphis Dry Rub jar.

row.subject: Memphis Dry Rub jar arrived broken
row.description:
Hi Smoke Ring folks. My order 2005 came Tuesday and the Memphis Dry Rub jar was cracked clean through, rub all over the box. I'd like a new jar or my money back on that one. Also, a friend at the market says Darnell sells by the case to shops. Could you send me his cell number, or the wholesale price list? I'd love to stock it at my stand.

Lorna Kessler

loud.description: The opening comment of Lorna Kessler's ticket.
